headline: Small and mixed today, but the tank fills up midweek — Thursday is the clean one.
today: Just 1-2ft of SSE at a fair angle with light winds bending onshore by afternoon. Dawn NW cross-off is the tidy window on the push to the 10:12 high, longboard fare only. Save your energy for later in the week.

daysToWatch.note: This is the drive: 1.6-2.4ft ESE at a prime angle with light W offshore 5-7mph all morning. Clean and rideable — fish or shortboard, best on the morning tide. Worth the 90 minutes.
Prime ESE angle with a 9s pulse, total to 3.2ft, but 11mph ENE cross-on to onshore keeps it textured. Dawn's your best shot.
Biggest swell of the week at 2.2-3.3ft, 6s+ prime ESE, total to 5.4ft — but NE cross-on 12-13mph works against it. Dawn before wind builds if you want size.
